title: 散文 10
content:
The past The present The future
I shiver when you place your hand upon mine.
I shiver when I know this will no longer be fine
My heart beats faster with every breath you take
And even slower knowing it doesn't long for me.
I love this girl that I once had
But this love for her is what makes me so sad.
I know she never loved me
Because all she wants is her heart to be free.
She says she doesn't need a man by her side
But she didn't plan on a man needing her to confide.
The problem wasn't me nor her.
But the difference in relationships we couldn't get over.
I prayed to god for her to be mine again,
It rained shortly after knowing it's the end.
I think of all the times we've kissed
And all the things I'm going to miss.
I heard our song just now,
And I just couldn't handle it somehow.
I broke down in tears of sorrow.
Because love is one thing you couldn't borrow.
Lover lay down please lay
Next to me I hope you would stay.
It's the end ready to leave
Hopefully someday she'll come back to me.
